name: Workspace Naming Guard
description: Keeps workspace names in a tidy 'Project｜Topic' form: adds the project prefix to the titles Orca gives new workspaces, fixes generic prefixes and suggests names for older ones. Once it has named a workspace, your own rename is final. Uses only Orca's plugin API.

statusBarItems.tooltip: Workspace Naming Guard keeps workspace names in Project｜Topic form

settings.title: Rename new workspaces automatically
settings.description: Off: Naming Guard only lists suggestions and renames nothing on its own.

settings.title: Project prefix aliases
settings.description: One per line: the project name as Orca shows it, '=', then the prefix to use. Example: 'my-api-v2 = API'. Lines starting with # are ignored.

settings.title: Give new workspaces a standby name right away
settings.description: Names a new workspace 'Project｜<label> 1a2b3c4d' as soon as it is created. This replaces Orca's own AI title for that workspace, so leave it off if you rely on those titles.

settings.title: Standby label
settings.description: The word used in standby names, such as Standby or 待命工作区.
